storyCards.headline: Rhythm Is Gonna Get You: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Gloria Estefan's "Rhythm Is Gonna Get You" reached #5 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #5 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 17 weeks on the chart.

Graph compilation anchor: "Greatest Hits" (1992) — not the song's original release year.

"Rhythm Is Gonna Get You" by Gloria Estefan.
